findings.finding: Game delivery is remote, not a locally recovered life simulation.

evidence.claim: only webpack bootstrap and an empty renderer module

findings.boundary: No conclusion about remote territory, armies, balance or NPC simulation.

findings.finding: The local menu separates Close, Return to Main Menu, Logout and Quit.

evidence.claim: separate handlers for quit, close, logout and home

findings.boundary: Handlers read statically; no rendered behavior or remote destination verified.

findings.finding: Faction join is a URL navigation affordance, not local faction mechanics.

evidence.claim: raw input prefix test before iframe navigation

findings.boundary: startsWith accepts similar host strings; path, host and token validation are not demonstrated. No faction membership or army rules recovered.

findings.finding: Steam identity and session continuity are delegated to cookies.

evidence.claim: eldyn.io session cookies extended fourteen days
writes Steam ID cookie before createWindow

findings.boundary: Authentication validity and server data are unknown; no cookies or saves inspected.

findings.finding: Shell UI is fullscreen with a floating menu and remote font.

evidence.claim: fullscreen window and modal popup override
floating bar and fixed-proportion hidden menu

findings.boundary: No keyboard/focus management, loading/error handler or menu pause policy found in inspected app-owned paths; this does not establish what remote iframe implements.
